title: 49ers K Eddy Piñeiro is questionable with an illness

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers K Eddy Piñeiro is questionable with an illness
sources.description: 49ers kicker Eddy Piñeiro is questionable to play against the Dolphins because of an illness. 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said the team will sign a kicker to the practice squad on Saturday as insurance in case Piñeiro can't play.
